title: Edible Solo #017 (블루베리 바닐라 아이스크림 · 체형 hourglass bombshell · 인종 Polynesian · 메이크업 비주얼계 블랙립 5단계 · 극한 · 배경 해안 절벽(화창한 낮) · 힐 40인치 · 몸 주얼리)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm bronze-brown complexion, late 30s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, shaggy layered auburn hair — full body soft-serve blueberry and vanilla ice cream fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is real ice cream curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, soft scoops and swirls slowly melting, thick creamy drips running down her body and pooling in puddles around her feet, nothing lying flat. Dense surface — BLAZING pale periwinkle-blue blueberry and cream-white vanilla swirls across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID whole blueberries and thick berry sauce swirls across the surface, with tiny sugar pearls pressed along the surface, glossy melting, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: full frontal, both hands framing the face, chin raised — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps made of the same ice cream, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, almond nails each as long as her forearm is wide, made of the same ice cream with a high polish.
Jewelry: a gold belly chain with a small pendant resting on her belly plate, heavy gold rings on every finger, and a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT ice cream — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Polynesian woman with a broad face, full lips and large dark eyes, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme: heavily smudged black eyeshadow blazing from the lash line up to the temples, thick smeared black liner all around the eyes, clumped black lashes top and bottom, fully opaque saturated jet-black lips, deeply shadowed black contour under the cheekbones.

Background: a bright coastal clifftop with a grassy path, a waist-high wooden safety rail, standard-height stone steps and a white lighthouse far behind her, in clear sunny daylight, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
